title: Policy Fee by Face Size — Term Life Insurance Face Decreases
content:
**Fee schedule.** For a Term Life Insurance face decrease, the fee before sharing is set at each face — the current face (the face amount on record) and the requested face (the new face amount on the approved face decrease request) — by the size of that face itself:

| Face | Fee before sharing |
|---|---|
| below 250000 | the product's annual policy fee less 10.00 |
| from 250000 up to 1000000 | the product's annual policy fee |
| 1000000 or more | the product's annual policy fee less 20.00 |

**Thresholds on both sides (hypothetical, annual policy fee 70.00).** A face of 249999 takes 60.00 and a face of 250000 takes 70.00; a face of 999999 takes 70.00 and a face of 1000000 takes 50.00.

**Example (hypothetical).** Current face 1200000 and requested face 800000 on an Ashgrove Level Term 25 (annual policy fee 70.00): fees before sharing of 50.00 and 70.00, a difference of minus 20.00 — the fee at the requested face is the higher one.
